selectedProcedure.activation: KEEP Action/120feet/V-S-F, Conjuration7/base17RP, one to three distinct actually perceived creatures with actual casting-point LoE. Select the complete target roster and actual body/support observations before commitment. No favorable post-roll roster edits.
selectedProcedure.NEW_duration_manifestation: Explicitly select concentration up to60elapsed seconds from successful resolution, replacing historical Instantaneous for the trap manifestation only. The initial6d6 Fire remains one instantaneous paid event. NEW choose nonseparable magical molten-rock BONDS expressed around each admitted body, not physical cage stock or a separately damageable structural object. They create no collision, cover, floor, support, enclosure, suffocation, continuous lava damage, objectHP/AC, removable bars or salvage. This is a stated interpretation of the printed trap, not an inherited Bone Cage bar/floor model.
selectedProcedure.NEW_eligibility_and_fit: A trap branch requires a genuine current supported standing body with an actual grounded contact witness, complete nonoverlapping current occupied volume and room for a visible noncollision body-hugging expression. No unsupported/flying-body hover or forced new support is supplied. Known unsupported target makes that declaration observably ineligible before payment; choose a different legal roster first. A validly committed creature losing support or moving out of range/LoE before resolution is independently revalidated. If it remains a legal Fire recipient but lacks the grounded trap predicate, the paid initial Fire can resolve but no immobilized branch is formed; other valid recipients are not canceled.
selectedProcedure.NEW_damage_and_save: Roll one native6d6 Fire total per original cast, then apply that total independently through each actual recipient damage-root/defense/Wound/Death/concentration sequence. One actual root per actual recipient with original caster/Null preserved. The native CON save separately decides immobilization only: success means no trap, not an invented half-damage benefit. Roll each recipient CON save against the actual source-class DC. The initial Fire is not an on-enter or periodic source and never repeats on suppression/resumption/recast cleanup.
selectedProcedure.NEW_immobilization: For an eligible grounded recipient failing CON, attach only voluntary Speed0 to this source; it is not Restrained, Paralyzed, Incapacitated, attack advantage or whole-Action denial. Real independently permitted forced movement, body changes and legal transport remain their own rules. An actual completed relocation wholly away from the original grounded contact/anchoring footprint ends that trap child; the spell supplies no relocation permission. The target may use an actual Action for STR task against source DC to break its magical bonds, or repeat CON at the end of its own real regular turn; success ends only that child. These are explicitly NEW escape permissions, with no automatic roll on an extra turn or merely naming a task.
selectedProcedure.NEW_end_and_suppression: Each child retains original parent/recipient/DC/deadline; one successful caster replacement ends all that caster prior children without replaying Fire or healing damage. Local magical suppression disables that body child Speed0 and visual expression, preserving only the still-live source record and deadline. No physical matter can reappear inside a body because this selected manifestation has no solid body. When suppression ends, restore only the same still-live child if the original contact/grounding predicate still holds; a real completed escape already ended it. Parent concentration loss/death/termination/deadline ends all remaining children. Real body/gear custody, injuries and prior displacement remain. No structural attack target exists; ordinary actual dispel/termination and the explicit escape Action are the source removal routes.
selectedProcedure.case_status: All one-to-three recipient and unsupported-body branches remain required new case data.
